blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We present Multimodal Flow , a fully continuous generative model of language and vision.
Most unified multimodal models either model both language and quantized images as discrete tokens or combine discrete language prediction with continuous image generation.
The former introduces a visual quantization bottleneck.
The latter requires modality-dependent objectives and sampling procedures.
Fully continuous modeling avoids these trade-offs and enables a shared generative process, but remains underexplored for multimodal pretraining.
Multimodal Flow introduces a unified continuous architecture that integrates multimodal continuous representations with a shared chunk-causal flow backbone.
It organizes text blocks and images as ordered continuous hyperchunks, preserving textual token order and visual spatial structure.
The backbone learns a single vector field over these hyperchunks through Flow Matching.
Joint attention enables cross-modal interaction, while modality-specific feed-forward networks process each modality.
The model predicts multiple target chunks in parallel during training and generates hyperchunks sequentially at inference.
We instantiate MF-1 and pretrain it on multimodal data.
Across 0.6B, 1.2B, and 1.6B scales, continued pretraining consistently improves multimodal modeling. With only 150B pretraining tokens, MF-1 achieves an average score of 82.8 across GenEval and DPG-Bench and 75.3 across VQAv2, MMBench, and POPE, remaining competitive with unified models trained on substantially more data.
Under matched data, optimization, and parameter budgets, Multimodal Flow further outperforms representative hybrid and discrete models.
These results establish continuous chunk-based embedding flow modeling as a new fully continuous paradigm for unified multimodal modeling.
The related code and model are publicly released at github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Vision-language models have advanced visual understanding by conditioning text generation on images ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Tao et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
Recent unified multimodal models extend this setting by treating both text and images as generation targets within a single pretrained model ( Team, 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Zou et al., 2025 ) .
These advances raise a broader question: can language and vision share a generative process while preserving the representational fidelity and structure each requires? Doing so is nontrivial because language is organized as an ordered sequence of tokens, whereas images have dense spatial structure, and the two have traditionally relied on different representations and generation mechanisms.
blocks.zh:
视觉语言模型通过在图像上对文本生成进行调制,提高了视觉理解(刘等人,2023年;陶等人,2025年;曾等人,2026年).
最近的统一的多式联运模式扩展了这一设置,将文字和图像作为单一预先训练过的模型内的生成目标(Team, 2024;Zhou等人,2025;Wang等人,2024b;Zou等人,2025)。
这些进步提出了一个更广泛的问题:语言和远见能否分享一个基因过程,同时保持每个过程都需要的代表性忠诚和结构? 这样做是非三角性的,因为语言是按顺序排列的符号序列,而图像的空间结构密集,两者传统上依赖不同的表示和生成机制.

blocks.en:
Current unified models resolve this tension through two dominant paradigms.
Fully discrete models quantize images into visual tokens, placing both modalities in a shared categorical sequence ( Team, 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Xie et al., 2025 ) .
This alignment facilitates joint modeling, but makes visual fidelity dependent on the tokenizer: fine-grained details discarded by the tokenizer are unavailable to the model ( Tang et al., 2026 ) .
Hybrid discrete–continuous models instead retain continuous visual states and combine discrete language prediction with diffusion or flow for images ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ) .
They avoid visual quantization and permit interaction within a shared backbone, but language and vision remain governed by different objectives and sampling procedures.
As summarized in Figure 1 , neither paradigm simultaneously provides continuous visual states and a common generative process across modalities.
This motivates fully continuous modeling in embedding spaces, where language and vision can share a continuous objective and sampling mechanism while retaining modality-specific representations.
blocks.zh:
目前的统一模式通过两种主导模式来解决这种紧张关系.
完整的离散模型将图像量化成视觉符号,将两种模式置于一个共享的绝对序列中(Team,2024;Wang等人,2024b;Xie等人,2025.).
这种对齐有利于联合建模,但使得视觉的忠诚依赖于标致器:标致器丢弃的精细的纹理细节对于模型来说是没有的(Tang等人,2026年).
混合离散连续模型则保留连续的视觉状态,将离散语言预测与图像的传播或流动结合起来(周等人,2025年;马等人,2025年;李等人,2025年b)。
它们避免了视觉量化,并允许在共同的骨干内进行互动,但语言和视觉仍受不同目标和取样程序的约束。
如图1所概括,两个范式同时提供连续的视觉状态和跨模式的共同基因过程.
这激发了在嵌入空间中完全连续的建模,其中语言和愿景可以共享持续的目标和取样机制,同时保留特定模式的表示.

blocks.en:
The technical ingredients for this paradigm are now available.
Continuous diffusion and flow models are well established for visual generation ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Lipman et al., 2022 ; Ho et al., 2020 ) , and Embedded Language Flows (ELF) shows that contextualized text embeddings can also be modeled directly with Flow Matching ( Hu et al., 2026 ) .
Prior multimodal diffusion and flow systems further demonstrate continuous generation along multiple image–text paths ( Bao et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2025 ) .
These systems largely center on joint denoising or predefined cross-modal routes.
A framework that causally factorizes task-defined multimodal sequences and learns from text-only, image-only, and bidirectional paired data through the same continuous pretraining objective remains underexplored.
blocks.zh:
目前已有这一模式的技术要素。
对视觉生成的连续传播和流体模型早已建立(Esser等人,2024年;Lipman等人,2022年;Ho等人,2020年),嵌入式语言流体(ELF)显示,上下文的文本嵌入也可以直接与流体匹配模型(Hu等人,2026年).
以前的多式传播和流动系统进一步显示沿多种图象的连续生成(Bao等人,2023年;Li等人,2025年a; He等人,2025年).
这些系统主要集中于联合去名或预先确定的跨模式路线。
一个通过相同的连续预训目标,将任务定义的多模式序列因果要素化并从文本、图像和双向对等数据中学习的框架仍然没有得到充分利用。

blocks.en:
A direct approach would concatenate continuous text and visual embeddings and apply a shared flow model.
Concatenation alone, however, leaves three questions unanswered: what constitutes a generative unit for each modality, how those units form an ordered conditional process, and how the model can share cross-modal interaction while respecting modality-specific representation statistics.
We address these questions with Multimodal Flow .
First, modality-specific encoders map text blocks and images to continuous embeddings, forming hyperchunks that preserve text-token order and visual-grid structure, respectively.
These heterogeneous hyperchunks provide common units of conditional generation that can be arranged into task-defined multimodal sequences.
Second, a shared chunk-causal flow backbone conditions each target on preceding chunks while modeling positions within the target jointly.
Third, joint attention supports cross-modal interaction, while modality-specific feed-forward networks adapt computation to each representation space.
The corresponding decoders map generated states back to text or images.
Multimodal Flow thus shares generative dynamics and cross-modal interaction without forcing language and vision into a homogeneous representation. Figure 3 shows parallel target-chunk prediction during training and sequential generation at inference. The same backbone and objective support mixed multimodal pretraining and finetuning for visual question answering and text-to-image generation.
blocks.zh:
直接的方法将凝聚连续文本和视觉嵌入,并采用共享流模型。
然而,仅仅结合就有三个问题没有得到回答:每个模式的基因单元是什么,这些单元如何构成一个命令的有条件过程,模型如何在尊重特定模式的表示统计的同时分享跨模式的相互作用。
我们通过多式联运处理这些问题。
首先,特定模式的编码器将文本块和图像映射到连续嵌入,形成分别保存文本脚本顺序和视觉网格结构的超充子.
这些多样的超整流器提供了有条件生成的共同单位,可以被排列成任务定义的多式联运序列.
第二,一个共享的块-因果流骨干条件,每个目标在前块上,同时在目标内共同建模位置.
第三,联合关注支持跨模式互动,而模式特定向导网络则适应每个表示空间的计算.
相应的解码器映射生成状态回到文本或图像.
因此,多式联运流动在不将语言和远见逼迫为同一代表的情况下分享遗传动态和跨模式互动。 图3显示在培训和依次生成过程中平行的目标量预测。 同样的骨干和客观支持混合的多式联运预训和微调,用于视觉问答和文本到图像生成。

blocks.en:
We instantiate the framework as MF-1 and evaluate its pretraining, competitive performance, and transfer.
Across 0.6B–1.6B variants, longer pretraining and larger models generally improve language modeling, image captioning, and text-to-image generation.
With 150B pretraining tokens, the 1.6B MF-1 achieves competitive generation and understanding performance against established unified models, scoring 0.821 on GenEval, 83.44 on DPG-Bench, and an average of 75.3 across VQAv2, MMBench and POPE. Controlled comparisons also show that Multimodal Flow outperforms fully discrete and hybrid architectures on the evaluated multimodal tasks. Separately, under matched total training-token budgets of the 1.6B architecture, mixed pretraining raises SeedBench from 31.6 to 62.4 and MMBench from 36.0 to 67.2 relative to a randomly initialized flow backbone, demonstrating MF-1’s ability to transfer learned multimodal representations to downstream tasks.
Additional analyses favor semantic visual representations and modality-specific feed-forward networks, and show that the same classifier-free guidance (CFG) ( Ho & Salimans, 2022 ) mechanism can improve both text-to-image and image-conditioned text generation.
Together, these results support the feasibility, competitiveness, and transferability of continuous chunk-based embedding modeling on the evaluated language–image tasks.
Additional related work is discussed in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
我们立即将框架定为MF-1,并评估其预训、竞争性业绩和转让。
在0.6B-1.6B的变体中,较长的预训和更大的模型一般会改进语言模型、图像标题和文本到图像生成。
拥有150B预训符,1.6B MF-1在既定的统一型号上实现竞争性生成和理解性能,在GenEval上得分0.821分,在DPG-Bench上得分83.44分,在VQAv2,MMBench和POPE上平均得分75.3分. 控制下的比较还表明,多式联运在所评价的多式联运任务上完全超越了离散和混合结构。 另外,在1.6B结构的对应培训总预算下,混合预训将种子奔驰从31.6提高到62.4,而MMBench则从36.0提高到67.2,表明MF-1有能力将学到的多式联运表述转移到下游任务。
额外的分析有利于语义视觉表现和模式特有的feed-forward网络,并显示相同的无分类引导(CFG)(Ho & Salimans, 2022)机制可以改善文本到图像和图像条件的文本生成.
这些结果加在一起支持了在评估的语言-图像任务上不断嵌入块模型的可行性、竞争力和可转移性。
附录A讨论了其他相关工作。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • We introduce Multimodal Flow, a fully continuous framework that models language and vision in their respective embedding spaces under one Flow Matching objective. • We develop ordered hyperchunks and a chunk-causal backbone that preserve modality-specific structure, support task-defined multimodal sequences, and enable parallel target prediction followed by sequential generation. • We validate MF-1 through scaling, matched architecture comparisons, and downstream transfer, demonstrating the strong multimodal modeling capabilities of Multimodal Flow.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的主要贡献如下: 我们引入了多式联运流动,这是一个完全连续的框架,在一个流动匹配目标下,在各自嵌入空间中模拟语言和愿景。 我们开发订购的超堆和块-因果骨干,以保留特定模式的结构,支持任务定义的多式联运序列,并能够进行平行的目标预测,然后进行顺序生成。 我们通过规模化、匹配的架构比较和下游转让来验证MF-1,显示了多式联运的强大模式示范能力。

The attention outputs are then processed by modality-specific feed-forward networks and projected back to their respective continuous representation spaces.

blocks.en: During training, the chunk-causal mask allows multiple target chunks to be predicted in parallel. For a sequence containing multiple text blocks, we construct clean and perturbed views of each block. A perturbed target block can attend to all preceding clean chunks and its own perturbed state, but not to its clean counterpart or any future chunk. Multiple chunk predictions can therefore be computed in a single forward pass. Each target chunk receives an independently sampled flow timestep. Figure 3 (a) illustrates this parallel construction as part of the overall training procedure.

blocks.en: 2.3.3 Sequential Chunk Inference
blocks.zh: 2.3.3 序列春克推论

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 3 (b), the model generates chunks sequentially in the order specified by the task. Given a clean chunk prefix, the next target chunk is initialized from Gaussian noise. The model then integrates the learned vector field from t = 0 t=0 to t = 1 t=1 , conditioned on the preceding chunks. Once generated, the chunk is appended to the context before the model proceeds to the next chunk.
blocks.zh: 如图3(b)所示,模型按任务指定的顺序依次生成块。 鉴于一个干净的块前缀,下一个目标块由高斯噪音初始化. 模型然后将学习到的矢量字段从 t = 0 t = 0 到 t = 1 t = 1 ,以前面的块为条件. 一旦生成,该块将附在上下文中,然后模型再转到下一个块。

blocks.en: Chunk-causal attention ensures that the hidden states of completed chunks do not depend on future chunks, which enables KV caching. The keys and values of preceding clean chunks are cached at each layer. At each sampling step, only the current target chunk needs to be recomputed. Once generated, its clean state is added to the cache for subsequent chunks.

blocks.en: 2.4.2 Downstream Finetuning
blocks.zh: 2.4.2 下游微调

blocks.en: Downstream finetuning changes the task sequence and data, but not the model interface or objective. For visual question answering, a visual chunk and question chunks form the clean prefix, while answer chunks are text targets. For text-to-image generation, prompt chunks form the prefix and the image is the visual target. The frozen modality codecs are reused, and the chunk-causal backbone is initialized from mixed pretraining and optimized with the same ℒ flow \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{flow}} .
blocks.zh: 下游微调会改变任务序列和数据,但不改变模型接口或目标. 对于视觉问题回答,一个视觉块和问题块构成干净的前缀,而答案块是文本目标. 对于文本到图像生成,即时块构成前缀,图像是视觉目标. 冷冻模式编码器被重用,块-causal骨干从混合预训中初始化,并使用相同的L 流量 \ mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{flow}} 优化.

blocks.en: This separation between task specification and generative modeling is central to Multimodal Flow. Task-specific data and optimization adapt the pretrained backbone, while the chunk interface, causal factorization, and continuous objective remain the same across understanding and generation tasks.
blocks.zh: 这种任务规格与基因模型的分离是多式联运的关键。 针对特定任务的数据和优化调整预先训练的骨干,而块接口、因果因子化和连续目标在理解和生成任务方面保持不变。

blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate MF-1 on language modeling, image captioning, multimodal understanding, and image generation. Our main model has a 1.6B parameter flow backbone trained from scratch with 150B tokens. All MF-1 results in Tables 1 – 3 use the same checkpoint after 5B tokens of joint finetuning. We also compare 0.6B, 1.2B, and 1.6B variants under a common pretraining and evaluation protocol. Appendices B and C provide the model and codec configurations, training budgets, benchmarks, and evaluation sampling settings.

blocks.en: The image-generation comparisons show that MF-1 achieves the strongest compositional generation performance and the best long-prompt alignment among unified models. This indicates that jointly modeling language and images within a continuous generative process produces language representations that transfer effectively to text-conditioned image synthesis. MF-1 also performs strongly on multimodal understanding despite being trained from scratch on only 150B tokens. blocks.en: We analyze three design choices in MF-1: the continuous visual representation space, the balance between shared and modality-specific computation, and CFG for text and image generation.

blocks.en: 3.5.1 Continuous Visual Representation Space
blocks.zh: 3.5.1 连续视觉表现空间

These results show that the same continuous flow formulation supports CFG for both text and image generation, with the guidance strength adjusted according to the output modality.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced Multimodal Flow , a fully continuous model for language–vision pretraining, instantiated as MF-1 .
It organizes text blocks and images as ordered hyperchunks and models them with a shared chunk-causal flow backbone, preserving modality-specific structure within a common generative process.
The resulting framework expresses diverse language–vision tasks as ordered hyperchunk sequences, unifying multimodal understanding and generation under a single continuous objective.
Experiments show gains with increased model scale and training tokens, competitive generation and understanding performance, and substantial downstream benefits from mixed pretraining.
Together, these results establish continuous hyperchunk modeling as a flexible paradigm for multimodal pretraining and show its ability to learn transferable representations across language and vision.
Extending it to longer interleaved sequences, video, and other structured modalities remains a promising direction.
We leave it as future work.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了多式联运,一种完全连续的语言-视觉预训模式,即MF-1。
它将文本块和图像按顺序排列,并以共享的块-因子流主干进行模型化,在一个共同的基因过程内保留特定模式的结构。
由此产生的框架以命令的超整齐序列、统一多式联运理解和在单一连续目标下生成等形式表达不同的语言-视觉任务。
实验显示,模型规模和培训标志增加,生成和理解业绩具有竞争力,混合预训在下游产生很大好处。
这些结果共同建立了连续的超充模式,作为多式联运预训的灵活范例,并表明它有能力学习跨语言和跨愿景的可转移表述。
将其扩展至较长的互页序列,视频,以及其他结构化模式,仍然是一个很有希望的方向.
我们把它留给未来的工作。

blocks.en: A.1 Discrete and Hybrid Discrete–Continuous Multimodal Modeling
blocks.zh: A.1 差异和混合差异-持续多式联运模式

blocks.en: Generative foundation models for language and vision have largely followed two architectural paradigms: fully discrete and hybrid discrete–continuous modeling. Fully discrete models use a visual tokenizer to map images into discrete visual tokens. Text and images can then form a common discrete sequence and be modeled through autoregressive prediction, masked diffusion, or discrete flow ( Team, 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . This design aligns the state type, prediction target, and generative process across modalities, while allowing the model to reuse established language model training recipes. For images, however, representation quality is bounded by the visual tokenizer. Improving reconstruction fidelity generally requires a larger codebook or longer token sequences, while information lost through quantization cannot be fully recovered by the downstream backbone ( Yao et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言和视觉的基因基础模型主要遵循两个建筑范式:完全离散和混合离散-连续模型。 完全离散的模型使用视觉示意器将图像映射成离散的视觉符号. 然后文本和图像可以形成一个常见的离散序列,并通过自旋预测,遮掩扩散,或离散流进行模型化(Team,2024;Wang等人,2024b;Xie等人,2025;Yang等人,2026;Wang等人,2026). 这种设计将状态类型,预测目标,以及跨模式的基因过程相配合,同时允许模型重新使用既定的语言模型培训配方. 然而,对于图像,表现质量以视觉示意器为界. 改善重建忠诚度一般需要更大的代码或更长的符号序列,而通过量化损失的信息则无法被下游骨干完全回收(姚等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Hybrid discrete–continuous models preserve discrete language modeling while generating continuous visual representations with diffusion or flow. A representative design retains autoregressive next-token prediction for text and pairs it with a continuous generation objective for images ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . Other systems replace the autoregressive language objective with discrete diffusion or related flow-based objectives ( Li et al., 2025b ; Nguyen et al., 2025 ) . These models avoid visual quantization, but a single system must still coordinate different training objectives, perturbation schedules, and sampling procedures.
blocks.zh: 混合的离散-连续模型保留离散语言模型,同时产生具有扩散或流动的连续视觉表现. 具有代表性的设计保留了文本的自递性下接预测,并配以图像连续生成目标(周等人,2025年;邓等人,2025年;马等人,2025年;郭等人,2025年). 其他系统用离散扩散或相关流基目标取代自递性语言目标(Li等人,2025b;Nguyen等人,2025年)。 这些模型避免视觉量化,但单一系统仍必须协调不同的训练目标,扰动时间表,以及取样程序.

blocks.en: A.2 Continuous Generative Modeling of Language and Vision
blocks.zh: A.2 语言和远景的持续基因模型化

blocks.en: Continuous diffusion and flow models are now widely used for visual generation. They typically learn probability paths from noise to data in reconstruction-oriented VAE latent spaces ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Lipman et al., 2022 ; Yao et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Representation Autoencoders further incorporate pretrained visual encoders, producing continuous generative states with richer semantic information and spatial structure ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Tong et al., 2026 ) . More recently, continuous generative modeling has been extended to language. One line of work operates directly in token-level embedding spaces, while another compresses sentences or text blocks into continuous latents and recovers discrete text with a language decoder ( Li et al., 2022 ; Gong et al., 2022 ; Lovelace et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) . Together, these studies demonstrate continuous language generation across different representation granularities, ranging from token-level embeddings to compressed sentence- and block-level latents.
blocks.zh: 持续的传播和流线模型现在被广泛用于视觉生成. 它们通常在面向重建的VAE潜在空间中学习从噪音到数据的概率路径(Rombach等人,2022年;Peebles & Xie,2023年;Lipman等人,2022年;Yao等人,2022年)。 2024; 朱等, 2025; 张等, 2025; 朱等, 2026. 代表权 自动编码器进一步融入了预先训练的视觉编码器,产生具有较丰富的语义信息和空间结构的连续基因状态(郑等人,2026年;唐等人,2026年). 最近,持续的基因建模已经扩展到语言。 一行工作直接在符号级嵌入空间中运行,另一行将句子或文本块压缩成连续潜伏,用语言解码器回收离散文本(Li等人,2022年;Gong等人,2022年;Lovelace等人,2023年;Hu等人,2026年;Guo等人,2026年). 这些研究共同表明,从符号级嵌入到压缩句子级和块级潜伏,不同代表颗粒的语源不断生成。

blocks.en:
Prior studies have established continuous multimodal generation through composable diffusion, joint denoising, and cross-modal flows ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2023 ; Bao et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025b ; He et al., 2025 ) .
Many nevertheless generate from reconstruction-oriented VAE latents or compact visual tokens rather than semantic representations.
These approaches also tend to couple modalities through joint denoising or direct mappings, without explicitly treating token-ordered text and spatially structured images as units of an ordered conditional sequence.
Meanwhile, mixed pretraining of a randomly initialized continuous backbone on multimodal data remains largely unexplored.
Multimodal Flow addresses these gaps by organizing contextual text embeddings and spatial semantic visual embeddings into ordered hyperchunks and modeling them with one chunk-causal Flow Matching objective.
MF-1’s scaling, transfer, and controlled comparisons show that this formulation can serve as a practical foundation for multimodal pretraining beyond cross-modal generation.
blocks.zh:
以往的研究已经通过可混合扩散、联合去诺和跨模式流动建立了连续的多式联运生成(徐等人,2023年;唐等人,2023年;鲍等人,2023年;李等人,2025年a;刘等人,2025年b;贺等人,2025年b)。
然而,许多工具来自注重重建的VAE潜在或紧凑的视觉符号,而不是语义表达。
这些方法还倾向于通过联合点名或直接绘图来对两种模式进行组合,而没有明确将令牌排列的文字和空间结构的图像作为命令有条件序列的单位。
同时,在多式联运数据上随机初始化连续主干线的混合预训基本上仍未加以探讨。
多式联运 Flow通过组织上下文的文字嵌入和空间语义视觉嵌入到命令的超充子中,并以一个块-因果流匹配目标来模拟这些缺口.
MF-1的缩放、转移和有控制的比较表明,这种提法可以作为超越跨模式生成的多式联运预训的实际基础。

blocks.en: C.2 Benchmarks and Metrics
blocks.zh: C.2 基准和计量

blocks.en: We evaluate generated text using GPT-2-large perplexity ( Radford et al., 2019 ) , an external fluency metric rather than the flow model’s likelihood. Image captioning is evaluated on the COCO Karpathy test split ( Lin et al., 2014 ; Karpathy & Fei-Fei, 2015 ) using CIDEr ( Vedantam et al., 2015 ) and CLIPScore ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们用GPT-2-大型复杂度(Radford等人, 2019年)来评价生成的文本, 图片字幕在COCO Karopathy测试分解(Lin等人,2014年;Karopathy & Fei-Fei,2015年)上通过CIDER(Vedantam等人,2015年)和CLIPScore(Hessel等人,2021年)评价.

blocks.en: We report POPE ( Li et al., 2023 ) , MMBench ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , SEED-Bench ( Li et al., 2024a ) , VQAv2 ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) , GQA ( Hudson & Manning, 2019 ) , and OK-VQA ( Marino et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们报告POPE(Li等人,2023年),MMBench(Liu等人,2024年b),SEED-Bench(Li等人,2024年a),VQAv2(Goyal等人,2017年),GQA (Hudson & Manning, 2019),和OK-VQA (Mino等人, 2019).

blocks.en: GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) and DPG-Bench ( Hu et al., 2024 ) assess compositional generation and long-prompt adherence, respectively. Lower values are better for perplexity; higher values are better for the other reported metrics.
blocks.zh: GenEval(Ghosh等人,2023年)和DPG-Bench(Hu等人,2024年)分别评估了组分生成和长期坚持性. 低值更能处理复杂问题;高值更能处理其他报告指标。
